blocks.text: Frankie Pangilinan has nothing but love and appreciation for her non-showbiz boyfriend, Daniel Laurel, as they celebrate their first anniversary as a couple. The actress-singer marked the occasion by sharing memories of their time together on her Instagram page on Tuesday, Oct. 6. One of the photos shows Laurel spending time with her family including her father, Sen.
